name: Noble Duelist (Combat)
body:
You are a high-society duelist and know how to fight against nobles.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nobility) 6 ranks, 1st-level Duelist

Benefit: You gain a +3 bonus to your Initiative rolls when beginning a battle with a noble or member of a ruling class, in addition to all Charisma-based skill checks made against such opponents during combat. With 12 or more ranks in Knowledge (nobility), this bonus increases to +6.
